one_line_description.value: Adobe Commerce (formerly Magento) is an ecommerce platform for B2B and B2C with API-first extensibility and backend integration.
one_line_description.quote: Adobe provides developers with software, tools, and services to customize and extend Adobe Commerce to support multichannel, global commerce for B2B and B2C, and integrate with backend systems.

has_public_api.quote: Alternatively, use Adobe Commerce’s REST or SOAP APIs for external integration with your translation service.

verdict_reason: Adobe publishes public developer documentation and REST/SOAP web APIs, and Magento Open Source is available on GitHub for self-serve developer use. API authentication uses OAuth 1.0a integrations, and no sales-contact, partner, or app-review gate is documented in the evidence.
open_questions: Official MCP server endpoint not found; Adobe's German product page mentions an 'MCP-Ebene' (MCP layer) but provides no vendor MCP server URL.
A GitHub repo (https://github.com/magenable/magento-adobe-commerce-mcp-server) appeared in search results but was not fetched in SOURCES, so community MCP support is unverified.
Rate limits are not documented in the fetched sources.
Webhooks/event callbacks are not documented in the fetched sources; the developer portal only mentions 'Event-driven integrations'.
No documented sandbox/test environment was found; a community post discusses a plugin's lack of a test mode, not a platform sandbox.
No official vendor-maintained SDKs were found in the evidence.
OAuth scopes/permissions documentation was not confirmed; integrations are documented as resource-scoped, but 'scopes' are not named.
Exact REST/SOAP API endpoint/resource count is not in the evidence.
Magento vs Adobe Commerce ambiguity: Magento Open Source is the open-source/self-serve path, while Adobe Commerce Cloud/enterprise access terms are not detailed in the evidence.
Auth mechanism is OAuth 1.0a (mapped to 'other'), not OAuth2; standalone bearer tokens can be enabled per S5 but are not included in the auth_methods claim.
